scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.deploy:legiscan: npm run build:web && npm run migrate:legiscan:remote && wrangler deploy --env legiscan && npm run smoke:legiscan
scripts.migrate:legiscan:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply central-bills-ls --local --env legiscan
scripts.migrate:legiscan:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply central-bills-ls --remote --env legiscan
